landing.label: Landing pages
landing.help: Pages made for ads at /l/<link>: one product, its offer and an order box on the page. You build and publish them in Marketing › Landing pages; the shop shows none of them to customers until this switch is on. Search engines never list them. Every order from a page carries the page's name.

referrals.label: Referral programme
referrals.help: Off as it ships. On (and inside its first and last day), a signed-in customer sees his own invite code under My account › For you, and a friend who types it on his first order gets the offer of the Smart Rule you pick (a rule whose offer asks for a code; its amount is the rule's). Once the friend's order is delivered, the customer who shared the code may get the wallet reward you set here, given by a person with the wallet permission after a confirm. Empty reward = none.

youtube.label: YouTube module
youtube.help: Off as it ships. On, Marketing › YouTube lets you add your channel and your videos (by their links), tie each video to the products it shows, and copy each product's tracked link for the video's description. Orders placed through those links are counted for the video (placed, delivered, delivered value). "Source" and "Medium" are the campaign tags the link carries; "Campaign prefix" goes before the video's id. Nothing is posted to YouTube and no money is spent.

outreach.label: SEO outreach pipeline
outreach.help: Off as it ships. On, Marketing › SEO outreach keeps the websites you ask for a link to your shop, each along the pipeline: found, asked, answered, link live or said no — with the person to write to, your notes, the day to follow up and the page where your link went live. "Follow-up days" sets the follow-up day by itself when you mark a site as asked (0 = none). The pitch words are your own first e-mail ({site} = the site, {shop} = your shop's address); "Write to them" only opens your own e-mail app with them, and you press send yourself. Nothing is sent from the shop.

seasonalHome.label: Seasonal home-page switching
seasonalHome.help: Off as it ships. On, Marketing › Seasonal home keeps your saved home-page looks (for example "Eid 2027": which sections show and in what order, the hero's words, the collection whose products slide in the hero) and the windows you schedule them for. Inside a window the home page shows that look; when the window ends the home page is your own home settings again by itself. Two windows may not overlap; a stopped schedule is kept, never deleted. Prices, offers and the checkout never change.

festiveCutoff.label: Festive cut-off banners
festiveCutoff.help: Off as it ships. On, your live festive Smart Rules (each with its last order time per delivery band) speak on the shop: before the time their short words, for example "Order by 6 Mar for delivery before the festival"; after it their "after" words. Places: the home page's festive section, under the product page's stock line, and at checkout and on the thank-you page, where a band already past its time gets the "after" words instead of the usual hours promise. The heading and the link of the home section are optional, in both languages. Every date and word comes from the rule; nothing is made up.

calendar.label: Marketing calendar
calendar.help: Off as it ships. On, Marketing › Calendar shows in one place, day by day on the shop's clock, what is planned across marketing: campaigns, the ads running, message sends, seasonal home windows, festive cut-offs, blog and social posts, and your own plan lines such as "Eid" or "Winter sale". "Days" is how many days one view shows; the Campaigns page shows the same view. The calendar only reads: it never starts, stops or sends anything.

report.label: Marketing report
report.help: Off as it ships. On, Marketing › Report sets what marketing cost (the ad spend imported per day and the cost of message sends) against Ordered value (orders placed) and Sales (orders delivered, the only sale), for the whole shop, by channel, by campaign and per message send, with delivered ROAS (Sales for each taka spent). "Longest period" is the most days one report covers; "Result days" is how many days after a message its receiver's orders count as that send's result. The report only reads: it never changes a budget, a campaign, a price or an order.

audiences.label: Audiences sent to ad platforms
audiences.help: Off as it ships: no list leaves the shop. On, “Send now” on an audience sends its people to Meta, TikTok and Google as hashed phone numbers (never a name or a plain number). A lookalike is made only where you set its countries and size. A list smaller than the floor you set for a platform is not sent. No budget or campaign is changed.

refusedExclude.label: Leave out people who refused a parcel
refusedExclude.help: Off as it ships: the list is never sent. On, the numbers a person put on the refused-parcel list (Orders › Returns › Refused) are sent to Meta, TikTok and Google as hashed phone numbers whenever audiences are sent, so campaigns can leave them out. You can also add every number with a parcel refused at the door that was not the shop’s fault, in your last N days (0 = any time). Never a block: they can still buy.

audienceRefresh.label: Refresh audiences every day
audienceRefresh.help: Off as it ships. On, once a day from your hour (store time) every live audience is counted again, the ones already sent to a real ad account are sent again, and the refused-parcel list too. No budget or campaign is changed.

spendImport.label: Import ad spend every day
spendImport.help: Off as it ships. On, once a day from your hour (store time) the shop reads what Meta, TikTok and Google spent per campaign over the last few days and keeps it for the profit figures. Read only: no budget or campaign is changed.

costAlerts.label: Ad cost alerts
costAlerts.help: Off as it ships. On, right after each daily spend import the shop checks your alert rules (cost per order or per delivered order over your limit) over the last few days and sends the crossed ones to your Telegram. An alert never pauses a campaign or changes a budget.

campaignControl.label: Campaign controls (pause and budget)
campaignControl.help: Off as it ships. On, Marketing › Ad platforms shows pause and budget controls for each platform campaign: pausing or lowering the daily budget happens after a confirm step; starting again or raising the budget waits for your approval and nothing changes until you approve. Until a platform is connected for changes, every change goes to its practice copy.

campaignBuilder.label: Campaign builder (new, duplicate, schedule, launch)
campaignBuilder.help: Off as it ships. On, Marketing › Ad platforms › New campaigns lets your ads staff write a new campaign or duplicate one as a draft, and schedule when a campaign starts and ends. Launching a campaign and every schedule change always wait for your approval: nothing starts and no money is spent until you approve. Needs the campaign controls on too. Until a platform is connected for changes, everything goes to its practice copy.

growthAgent.label: AI growth agent (proposals)
growthAgent.help: Off as it ships. On, right after each daily spend import the agent reads delivered sales against ad spend (delivered ROAS) by campaign, product and district and turns your limits into proposals — pause, lower or raise a budget, refresh a creative, build an audience. Each one waits for your approval and nothing changes until you approve. A limit of 0 keeps that kind of proposal off.

creativeBrief.label: Creative briefs for ads
creativeBrief.help: Off as it ships. On, Marketing › Ad platforms › Creative briefs writes a brief for the studio from a product and, if you pick one, a platform campaign: the offer, the formats, a hook in Bengali and English, what the picture shows, the landing page and what the ads optimise for. You correct the words and send it to the studio. A brief never changes a price, a budget or a campaign.
